summary: Residential kerb where cars park, but houses sit 12-15 m away on this side.

best_section.where: Boundary Road north kerb, just west of the corner

drivers.seclusion: Houses line the north side 12-15 m from the kerb all along; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Open road with cars parked at the kerb; room for a van among them.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the kerb; sign is 4P on school days 9am-5pm only.

flags: Dwellings 12-15 m away on same side
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees on the south side shade the afternoon.
